summary.en: Every particle, including electrons, has an associated wavelength, and every wave, including light, can transfer energy and momentum in discrete particle-like packets.
summary.et: Igal osakesel, sealhulgas elektronil, on oma lainepikkus, ning iga laine, sealhulgas valgus, võib kanda energiat ja impulssi diskreetsete osakestesarnaste pakettidena.
